snippet.title: MEMOREUM Gameplay Trailer - Coming to Meta Quest 2025
snippet.description:
MEMOREUM is a VR sci-fi action horror campaign. The Ichor Infection has taken over the last ship of humanity. You are Dr. Otto Hudson, fighting to unravel the mystery behind the outbreak as your fragmented mind slips from reality.

Wishlist on Meta Quest: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/memoreum/9135633756555622/

Wihslist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3574740/MEMOREUM/

To learn more, join our Discord: https://discord.gg/6ujT69VsQg
